candidate: H49 top-1 three-expert binary complete-neuron manifold

parent_evidence.causal_transition: H47/H48 static shared banks fail the latency gate and short-fit layer alignment. Decouple stored piecewise functional capacity from active width through a top-1 union of three paired complete-neuron experts.

scientific_question: Can real top-1 dispatch over three aligned width-1024 complete-neuron experts, including router, grouping, gather and scatter, execute at no more than 0.65 times a width-3072 dense MLP at both 512 and 4096 tokens?

architecture.expert_semantics: Each expert owns both its c_fc detector and c_proj residual-write projection; detector/write pairing is indivisible.
architecture.router: one learned three-way affine router per layer

future_representation_if_systems_pass.global_carrier: one-bit signs for all three paired experts plus one FP16 scale per endpoint row
future_representation_if_systems_pass.private_transport: rank-two layer-private detector and write endpoint transports
future_representation_if_systems_pass.layer_gains: one FP16 gain per layer and global neuron
future_representation_if_systems_pass.binding_audit: all-layer heldout output RMSE <=0.10, exact input-JVP RMSE <=0.15, centered covariance retention >=0.90

frozen_systems_discriminator.dense_reference: two FP16 GEMMs with width 3072 plus GELU
frozen_systems_discriminator.skewed_route: router plus argmax, nonzero/index-select, one nonempty expert GEMM pair and index-copy
frozen_systems_discriminator.balanced_route: deterministic random affine router plus argmax, nonzero/index-select for three approximately balanced experts, three GEMM pairs and index-copy
frozen_systems_discriminator.prepartitioned_lower_bound: same balanced token partition with routing indices cached outside the timed body; reports an optimistic grouped-dispatch lower bound but cannot pass H49 by itself

promotion: Only a systems pass authorizes implementation of the identical binary/rank-two all-layer function-JVP representation audit. It does not authorize CE.
failure: Close exact top-1 three-by-1024 reference-dispatch H49 without expert-count, width, rank, bits, kernel, CE or scale sweep. A future custom-kernel family requires separate theory and preregistration.
forbidden: function fitting or CE before this systems gate passes
excluding router, grouping, gather or scatter from binding latency
treating the prepartitioned lower bound as an actual dispatch pass
expert-count, width, rank, bitwidth, route, token-count or threshold sweep
calling materialized expert caches compact checkpoint state
